2B.10 We are to put our trust in God as our help and shield (for he who trusts in the LORD, mercy shall surround him).
2L.6 We are exhorted to acknowledge our transgressions and iniquity and confess them to God.
2L.8 He who covers his sins will not prosper, but whoever confesses and forsakes them will have mercy.

precepts.why: This is a beautiful chapter. “Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered.” “When I kept silence, my bones waxed old through my roaring all the day long.” “I acknowledged my sin unto thee”: King David eventually got to that point after he got checked by the prophet. “I said, I will confess my transgressions unto the Lord; and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin.” When you confess your transgression to the Lord and you stop it, stop the fornication, the adultery, the pornography, that’s when the Most High forgives you. “For this shall every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found”.

note.label: | SABBATH MORNING CLASS: When The Harvest Is Ripe

precepts.why:
“I acknowledged my sin unto thee”: that is what we have to do. That is the first step in repentance, acknowledging it and making supplication. “And mine iniquity have I not hid”: you have to come clean with that thing.

“I said, I will confess my transgressions unto the Lord; and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin.” So if we want to be forgiven, if we want to be justified, we have to confess our sins. That is how the command to repent is answered.

moments.label: The Mercy and Humility of King Manasseh
Nehemiah Squad Radio | Narcissism Amongst Blacks and Hispanics

points: Thou art my hiding place, thou shalt preserve me from trouble. Even if trouble comes, if you are rooted, the Father gets you out; what seems bad is a trial and a test.
Be ye not as the horse or the mule which have no understanding: they have no guide, they are foolish, simple and faithless and can be swayed anywhere, held in with bit and bridle.
Many sorrows shall be to the wicked, those foolish like the five virgins; but mercy shall compass him that trusteth in the Lord.

Shout for joy, all ye upright in heart: those with a clean conscience. We are going to fall, but get up and keep fighting until Christ cracks the sky or this shell is in the dirt. Never give up, never give in.

When I kept silence, my bones waxed old through my roaring all the day long. That is what happens with a lot of men: when they are dealing with stuff, they keep silence. Men may come for counsel on how to study better or break down scriptures, but the classes we really need, dealing with what goes on inside our households, our families, our personal lives, we do not really like those classes. Those are the best classes; that is what we need to build ourselves up as a nation.

Day and night thy hand was heavy upon me. This is really dealing with holding your sin in, but a lot of times we hold our emotions in too. Then you start dealing with regret: what if, why didn't I. You think about how you treat your wife. In that song the brother is thinking about his wife not making it, and hindsight is 20/20.
I acknowledged my sin unto thee and mine iniquity have I not hid; I said I will confess my transgressions unto the Lord, and thou forgavest. David held himself accountable, and so must you.

note.label: The Mercy and Humility of King Manasseh

points: These issues can be fixed, but you have to acknowledge it, and part of that is acknowledging your sin. Once you acknowledge your sin and come to the Lord, he's going to heal you of all of it, the murderous tendencies, the violence.

points: Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven and whose sin is covered, blessed is the man unto whom the Lord imputeth not iniquity and in whose spirit there is no guile.

note.label: Psalm 32: Blessed Is He Whose Transgression Is Forgiven

points: When I kept silence my bones waxed old through my roaring all the day long, for day and night thy hand was heavy upon me, my moisture is turned into the drought of summer.

note.label: Psalm 32: Blessed Is He Whose Transgression Is Forgiven

points: I acknowledge my sin unto thee and my iniquity have I not hid, I said I will confess my transgressions unto the Lord and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. That is heavy. A lot of our people say they are not sinning and ask what sin they are doing, but there is none of us that has not sinned, and that is something we have to be aware of on a daily basis.

note.label: Psalm 32: Blessed Is He Whose Transgression Is Forgiven

points: For this shall every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found, surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come nigh unto him. Thou art my hiding place, thou shalt preserve me from trouble and compass me about with songs of deliverance.

note.label: Psalm 32: Blessed Is He Whose Transgression Is Forgiven

points: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go, I will guide thee with mine eye. Be ye not as the horse or as the mule which have no understanding, whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle.

note.label: Psalm 32: Blessed Is He Whose Transgression Is Forgiven

points: Many sorrows shall be to the wicked, but he that trusteth in the Lord, mercy shall compass him about. Be glad in the Lord and rejoice ye righteous, and shout for joy all ye that are upright in heart.
